Shitet apartament 2+1 -Komuna e Parisit
Apartamenti ndodhet ne rrugen Medar Shtylla, te nje ndertimi te ri dhe cilesor ne nje nga zonat me te kerkuara te Tiranes, Komuna e Parisit. Objekti eshte i sapo perfunduar, i vitit 2025 dhe me fasade te ventiluar.
Prona organizohet ne sallon ndenjeje dhe ambient gatimi, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, korridor.
Apartamenti ofron ndricim natyral te mire dhe planimetri te rregullt.
Sip totale: 106.6 m2
Ndodhet prane te gjitha faciliteteve, duke ofruar nje stil jetese shume komod

description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale - Municipality of Paris The apartment is located on Medar Shtylla Street, in a new and quality building in one of the most sought after areas of Tirana, Municipality of Paris. The building is newly completed, from 2025 and with a ventilated facade. The property is organized in living room and kitchen area, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, corridor. The apartment offers good natural lighting and a neat layout. Total area: 106.6 m2 Located near all facilities, offering a very comfortable lifestyle
